sentences.text: 1  THE COMPENSATION AS PER THE TERMS AND CONDITIONS OF THE  POLICY IN THE INTEREST OF JUSTICE AND EQUITY.

THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY, THE  COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 -2-  NC: 2024:KHC-D:11475  RP No. 100114 of 2024  ORAL ORDER

This review petition is filed seeking to review the judgment dated 27.3.2024 passed in MFA No.102660/2023, on the ground that this Court has committed an error in directing the petitioner/insurance company to pay interest at the rate of 12% per annum on the compensation amount to the claimant, as the policy specifically excludes payment of penalty and interest.

2. Learned counsel Sri. Harish S Maigur for respondent No.1/claimant and Sri. Anjaneya M, learned counsel for respondent No.2/owner submit that there is no error apparent on the face of the record calling for interference in the present review petition.
Thus, seek dismissal of review petition.
3. I have heard the arguments of learned counsel for the parties and perused the material on record.
4. This Court vide judgment dated 27.3.2024 in MFA No.102660/2023 has confirmed the award of the trial Court, insofar as the liability and entitlement of compensation is concerned.
However, this Court has enhanced the compensation amount awarded in ECA No.17/2020 of the trial Court to certain extent.
It is not in dispute that the insurer has NC: 2024:KHC-D:11475 not challenged the judgment and award dated 28.3.2023 passed in ECA No.17/2020 of the trial Court.
Hence, without challenging the said judgment of the trial Court, the petitioner/insurer now cannot contend that they are not liable to pay interest.
Even such contention was not raised before the trial Court.
On this ground alone, review petition is liable to be rejected and accordingly, it is rejected.
Insofar as legal contention urged in the petition are kept open to be adjudicated in an appropriate proceedings.

Sd/-
(VIJAYKUMAR A.PATIL) JUDGE JTR/
